msg: Hi. We want to complete our PADI open water: we have referrals and e-learning certificates. We would also like a refresher first. How does the 2 day open water referral course cost plus a mini course the day before. 2 persons. Thanks
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

That sounds like a great plan! Since you have your referral paperwork and e-learning completed, the *2-day Open Water Referral Course* is the right option, as long as your referral paperwork is signed by a PADI instructor.

The refresher is booked as the Dive Mini Course. The referral course requires an overnight stay on the islands; accommodation isn’t included.

The referral course requires a PADI referral form signed by your original instructor; it is the “Open Water Referral Course,” not a regular dive trip.

One important note: the refresher is for certified divers. If you haven’t yet earned your Open Water certification, please check with a team advisor whether it’s appropriate for you before booking.

To give you the exact price I need to know where you're starting from: would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Plans and prices change depending on the departure point. 🌊

Yes! For the most convenient access, I’d recommend *Hotel San Pedro de Majagua* or *Hotel Cocoliso* on Isla Grande—both are our dive bases, and pick-up is direct. Other nearby hotels with maritime access include *Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras, and Pao Pao*.

msg: Great. We will book diving with you on the website and will book our hotel on the island . Hope you are operating on Easter Sunday? We want to dive on April 5 and 6. How do we book/pay for the $50 refresher course?
reply:
Yes! We operate every day of the year except December 25 and January 1 — so Easter Sunday is no problem. 🐠 April 5 and 6 are perfect for your plan.

One quick note on the refresher: it isn't $50. The refresher is booked as the *Dive Mini Course*, and the price depends on where you start from:

- *From Cartagena:* 183 USD online (204 USD regular) — includes boat Cartagena–Islands–Cartagena and lunch.
- *Already on the Rosario Islands:* 134 USD online (149 USD regular) — no lunch, hotel pick-up if your hotel has boat access.

Since you'll be staying on the island, the "already on the islands" option is the one that fits — and it's booked through the same link as the mini course:

👉 https://book.divingplanet.org/book/dive-mini-course-already-on-island/20?language=en

There you pick the date (the day before your referral course) and the number of people, and pay online with the 10% discount already applied. The system closes at 4:30 PM the day before, so just book before then.

For the *Open Water Referral Course* on the island (2 days, 432 USD online per person), here's the link:

👉 https://book.divingplanet.org/book/referral-already-on-the-island/26?language=en#rvrd-1

Remember to bring your referral paperwork signed by a PADI instructor, and you'll need to complete the medical form for the refresher: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol

Would you like me to walk you through anything else before you book? 🌊

A refresher and a certified diver can go on the same outing.

Which hotel or island are you staying at? That way we can arrange pickup.

El alojamiento no está incluido y se reserva directamente con el hotel. Si ya estás en las islas, la recogida está incluida cuando el hotel tiene acceso marítimo.
